facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at TK-4211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on TK-4211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-4211 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 6 October 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on TK-4211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
